Millbrook’s population growth from 2020 to 2025 was:

\[
\frac{37,203-34,590}{34,590}
\]

Applying the same percentage growth to the 2025 population:

\[
37,203 \times \frac{37,203}{34,590}=40,013.13
\]

Rounded to 0 decimal places, the projected 2030 population is **40,013**, so it will exceed 40,000.

ANSWER: yes | 40013

\[

\]

This exceeds 40,000 residents. Rounded to 0 decimal places: **40,014**.
